analysis.summary: This is a concentrated household bleach with sodium hypochlorite 6.0%. The label marks it DANGER and corrosive. Nothing on the label matches your allergies, warfarin, or vegan diet, but follow the safety steps.

labelWarnings.text: Causes irreversible eye damage and skin burns. Harmful if swallowed. Wear eye protection and rubber gloves.
labelWarnings.evidence: CORROSIVE. Causes irreversible eye damage and skin burns.

labelWarnings.text: Do not mix with ammonia, vinegar, toilet bowl cleaners, rust removers or other acids. Mixing releases hazardous gases.
labelWarnings.evidence: Do not mix with ammonia, vinegar, toilet bowl cleaners, rust removers or other acids.

labelWarnings.text: Use only in a well-ventilated area.
labelWarnings.evidence: Use only in a well-ventilated area.

labelWarnings.text: Keep out of reach of children. Store cool and dry, away from sunlight and heat.
labelWarnings.evidence: KEEP OUT OF REACH OF CHILDREN.

keyFacts.label: If in eyes
keyFacts.value: Rinse slowly with water for 15–20 minutes

keyFacts.label: If swallowed
keyFacts.value: Call a poison control center or doctor immediately

analysis.disclaimer: If someone swallows this product, call local emergency services or poison control right away and keep the label with you.
